review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: About Your New Role The Managed Services Network Engineer is a critical role responsible for supporting and delivering superior service to ISP/MSP business customers. You will play a key part in managing and troubleshooting SDWAN networks (with an emphasis on Versa Networks), business data circuits, VoIP services, VPNs, Managed Routers, Firewalls, and other custom-managed services. Key Responsibilities Provide end-to-end support for customers with a focus on SDWAN (preferably Versa Networks), In
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: What You'll Need For Success High School Diploma or GED Equivalent 3-5 years of relevant experience in a fast-paced technical environment, with demonstrated expertise in SDWAN, particularly Versa Networks. Deep understanding and hands-on experience with BGP, OSPF, and VRRP. We value the innovative spirit and seek individuals ready to bring their unique vision and expertise to a team that values bold ideas and strategic thinking. These tools support our recruiting team by identifying qualifications and experience that align with the requirements of each role.
